mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, main_id, sku_id, sku_no, product_name, delivery_qty, source_detail_id, fn_sku, source_code
mapper.select: select sum(delivery_qty) FROM packing_task_detail where main_id = #{taskId}

SELECT ptd.id, ptd.main_id, ptd.sku_id, ptd.sku_no, ptd.fn_sku, ptd.source_detail_id, pp.ean FROM packing_task_detail ptd LEFT JOIN product_purchase pp ON ptd.sku_id = pp.sku_id AND pp.is_deleted = FALSE where ptd.is_deleted = FALSE AND (COALESCE(ptd.sku_no, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(ptd.fn_sku, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(pp.ean, '')) ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKey}::text,'%')
AND ptd.main_id = #{taskId}
